name: Nut City Blues
source:
This is  a love story. 

You are Captain Fox, a venerated veteran police officer in NCPD - the Nut City Police Department. On a fateful day, Detective Racoon - a young, dumb and hot-headed pizza lover - joins the force and becomes your partner. From then on, your life is forever changed. 

Together as partners, Captain Fox and Detective Raccoon explore Nut City’s neon-washed streets, meet its strange citizens, and tackle bizarre cases. Danger looms around the corner, but love also blossoms.

Be careful of where to look and what to choose . Will the two of you form a deeper bond, or part ways in bitterness? 

[From [url=https://looking4stupid.itch.io/nut-city-blues]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个爱情故事。

你是福克斯队长，一位在NCPD（坚果城警察局）受人尊敬的资深警官。在命运攸关的一天，浣熊侦探 - 一位年轻、愚蠢且头脑发热的披萨爱好者 - 加入了部队并成为你的搭档。从那时起，你的生活将永远改变。

狐狸队长和浣熊侦探作为搭档，一起探索坚果城霓虹闪烁的街道，结识奇怪的居民，并解决离奇的案件。危险逼近，但爱情也在绽放。

小心去哪里寻找和选择什么。你们两个会建立更深的联系，还是在痛苦中分道扬镳？

[来自[url=https://looking4stupid.itch.io/nut-city-blues]Itch.io[/url]]
